codeReview.summary: The worker explored the full Glade stack startup and identified a missing BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100 environment variable in the web service's start command in .factory/services.yaml. Without this, Vite's WebSocket proxy defaulted to port 7842 (incorrect), causing ECONNREFUSED errors. The fix is a single-line, well-targeted change that adds the env var prefix to the start command. All expected behaviors were verified: Vite serves HTML on 5173, backend /health returns 200 on 3100, R process emits __GLADE_READY__, and the web app loads with workspace shell, explorer, inspector, and REPL panels. All 170 existing tests pass with no regressions.

issues.description: The BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100 is hardcoded in the web service start command. If the server service port changes (e.g., during parallel test runs), the web service would still proxy to 3100. Consider using a shell variable reference or documenting this coupling. However, this is acceptable for the current single-instance usage pattern documented in AGENTS.md.
